activity_summary: In the porch Richard Quiney took your hand in both of his and asked you as far as his shop, for the town. Anne put dinner ahead of the shop. You heard him, and you did not say yes. Tuesday at half past six is his coming to your father's table with Alderman Sturley, and the shop stays unpromised.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard the ask, and did not grant the shop.

entities.name: Richard Quiney
entities.context: Asked for the town, and took Tuesday at the house when the shop was refused.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Put dinner ahead of the shop, and fixed half past six as the table.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the south-west wind, and told Quiney to let your hand go.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Warned that Judith had the vicar's voice ready, and counted the nine.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept watch on the children ahead down Old Town.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
